Title: The Good Samaritan
Writer: Donald P. Bellisario, Don McGill, Jack Bernstein
Actors: Mark Harmon, Sasha Alexander, Michael Weatherly
Plot: A Navy dentist from a Naval air station dies of a single shot to his back, apparently in an execution-style murder; the NCIS investigates. Two more men from the same Naval air station soon die identically. Gibbs and company figure...
